Common.tagline: The commercial platform for Proamina® — the first patented 100% protein sweetener.

Landing.heroTitle: The operating system for the ITALPROTEIN business
Landing.heroSubtitle: One platform to manage companies, NDAs, samples, logistics, technical feedback and the commercial pipeline behind Proamina® — Italprotein's patented 100% protein sweetener.
Landing.platformNote: One connected platform for the Italprotein team and its partners — from first contact to delivered samples and technical feedback.

features.desc: Upload application trials and lab results straight to our R&D team from the portal.

features.desc: Build, save and share formulations and recipes using Proamina® with our technical experts.

Landing.partnersSubtitle: Brands and manufacturers already working with Proamina®.
Landing.journeyEyebrow: From formulation goal to recurring supply
Landing.journeyTitle: How a Proamina® relationship takes shape
Landing.journeySubtitle: A clear technical and commercial sequence keeps formulation detail, samples, feedback and supply decisions connected.

journey.title: First contact
journey.body: You tell us your product and your formulation goal. We come back with the technical data sheet and the dosage we would recommend for your application.

journey.title: NDA
journey.body: We sign a confidentiality agreement before going into formulation detail. From then on the full technical documentation is open to you in the portal.

journey.title: Sample
journey.body: We prepare and ship a batch-traced sample. You follow the shipment in the portal through to delivery confirmation.

journey.title: Application testing
journey.body: You run Proamina® in your recipe and upload the results from the portal. Our R&D team answers on the same record.

journey.title: Supply
journey.body: We agree volumes, price and recurring logistics. Orders, shipments and documents all stay in one place.
